name: brainspace
description: BrainSpace monorepo: run package scripts from the root. Each package keeps its own dependencies.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix e2e
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix e2e
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:rag && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:rag: cd rag && PYTHONPATH=tests/stubs python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
